|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/amillionvoices.html</ref>

Players who have been using the [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe{{!}}Set Your Course For Alderaan]] (SYCFA) objective from the Third Anthology set as the basis for their deck will be quite interested in this card. Since playing with [[Commence Primary Ignition]] (CPI) with SYCFA required either: 1) Using multiple copies of it and reducing your overall destiny, or 2) Ignoring the back side of the objective. With [[A Million Voices Crying Out]], you can grab it from your Reserve Deck or Lost Pile -- meaning 1 copy of CPI (ANH set) can be used twice and will do good damage. Now you too can be like [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] and say "You may fire when ready."

Once you have successfully blown away [[Alderaan (Dark){{!}}Alderaan]] and flipped SYCFA, you get to deploy Star Destroyers cheaper and with [[A Million Voices Crying Out]], you get an added bonus of retrieving 3 Force. Good stuff, eh? "This station is now the ultimate power in the universe. I suggest we use it!"

Okay, say you don't even like objectives. That's okay. All you need is the [[Death Star]] (ANH set) and [[Prepared Defenses]] (DSII set) and you can still go wreck havoc around the universe. Is the opponent playing an objective revolving around [[Tatooine (Dark){{!}}Tatooine]]? Is the opponent Jedi Training? Take care of [[Dagobah (Dark){{!}}Dagobah]] the clean and easy way... Blow it away! With this effect out, your opponent will agree that [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] is wrong. The ability to destroy a planet is pretty significant.
